integrity: The exposing-vector construction and obstruction proof are self-contained. No independent audit is claimed.
limitations: No higher-dimensional face enumeration, full f-vector, or lattice-point enumeration is asserted.
Finite exact checks and numerical LP tests are corroboration rather than proofs in arbitrary dimension.
The full text of Cho (1999) was not recovered; equivalent older formulations remain possible.
title: Exact 1-skeleton and simple-vertex exhaustion of transitive-tournament root polytopes
